sources.excerpt: Sharp Tooth sold out Sharp Tooth from $200.00 Loosely based on the 60’s (silicon) Orpheum but taken to a whole new place in Tonality and texture. The Sharp Tooth’s Texture control pans between one and two transistor stage so essentially you get a dirt boost all the way up to full on ripping fuzz. Sonically a cross between A tone bender MKI and a gritty light boost and any variation in between. 1.
